description:
Mining showed agents hand-rolling projections that existing commands already provide — the commands were never surfaced at the point of need. Evidence: 22 mid-task help probes, the per-issue gate status command and the gate run-history view going unused in favor of jq over full issue JSON, and event-log verification done by tailing the raw file.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] REQ-01: Issue show help points at the per-issue gate status command; gate failure output points at the run-history view; issue and doc mutation help points at the events commands for verification.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-02: Top-level help mentions the schema introspection command for JSON shapes and exit codes.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-03: Issue show help summarizes its JSON field names, including the dependency and gate collections.
title: Help cross-reference sweep for existing but undiscovered commands
